disclaimer: Metaphorical AV overlays for understanding invisible inner experiences. Not a diagnostic or medical tool.

conditions.label: Anxiety (Generalized / Social)
conditions.description: Metaphor of heightened baseline tension and increased threat-scanning attention (bounded, user-controlled).

conditions.label: Panic Disorder
conditions.description: Metaphor of brief, clamped alarm waves (rise/fall), with strong safety controls.

conditions.label: Depressive Disorder
conditions.description: Metaphor of reduced affective contrast and cognitive fog (subtle, non-stereotyped).

conditions.label: Trauma / PTSD (Hyperarousal + Intrusion)
conditions.description: Metaphor of heightened readiness + monitoring, with abstract intrusion-like interference (non-graphic, opt-out).

conditions.label: OCD (Intrusion + Compulsive Loop)
conditions.description: Metaphor of sticky loops + repeated-checking pressure (non-comedic), with gentle recursion and strong clamps.

conditions.label: Depersonalization / Derealization
conditions.description: Metaphor of 'behind-glass' distance and subtle time drift (avoid disorientation; user-controlled).

conditions.label: ADHD (Attention Fragmentation / Overload)
conditions.description: Metaphor of focus instability and sensory competition (comfort-first, Reduced Motion friendly).
